description: A context-fed value the receiving field's codec rejects is a type mismatch at the bound node, as an explicit supply is: the shelf slot holds Fiction, which ShelfName does not match, so Book.shelf fails KDLITH-BND003 at the book and no record is emitted; the slot's own String type admitted the value, so only the field's decode catches it

stderr-contains: error[KDLITH-BND003]: book.shelf expects optional<ShelfRef>, found string "Fiction"
